## Done so far
The edits are done but not committed. They are in worktree /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-kongpda-workspace-khable-ts-sati/75d3e4d7-ea67-4817-ae83-5e87152a70cd/scratchpad/wt19, branch wp14-tests, based on 6b887b4.
- 14.5: every skipIf/runIf in the tests has a one-line comment saying why it skips and where it runs instead.
- 14.4: no code change is needed. The core lock-service test already has a 30 s timeout with a reason, and the CLI config's 15 s covers its slow tests.
- The slow-test list is in docs/progress.md.
- 14.4 and 14.5 are ticked in docs/review-2026-11-12.md.
- Seven CLI tests timed out at about 80 s under load average 100. All seven pass when run alone.

## Next step
Free disk space, rerun the gate in wt19, then task complete, commit and push to main.

## Open questions
The gate cannot run: /System/Volumes/Data is 100% full (431 GB used, about 200 MB free). Tests fail with ENOSPC. Nothing in /private/tmp or the caches is large, so the owner must free space.
